Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

detailed_description:
The video is filmed in a modern, social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy and natural morning light. The color palette features crisp whites, warm skin tones, and pops of coral against neutral backgrounds. The atmosphere is airy with lifted shadows and a slight warmth in the highlights.

[Shot 1] Starting from the frame of <Image 1>, <Subject 2> is in a sunlit downtown bathroom, leaning over a whitetiled sink. She reaches into a light green scarf to find a subway card, but she pauses abruptly. Her attention snaps away from the card as she notices the red box of <Subject 3> resting nearby. The camera uses a brisk, natural handheld drift with micro-movements.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2>'s hands. She opens the packaging of <Subject 3> with a tactile paper crackle. She twists the lipstick <Subject 3> upward and performs a single swipe across the back of her hand. The vibrant coral shade pops sharply against her warm, natural skin tone. The camera performs a quick, tactile tilt focusing on the texture of the lipstick and the skin.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot shows <Subject 2> looking into the bathroom mirror as she applies <Subject 3> to her lips. In the background, the apartment door swings shut with a heavy thud and a soft latch click. Her reflection is lively as she gives a small, satisfied smile. The camera executes a smooth and quick push-in toward her face. <Subject 2> (S2) says softly <d>[English] Okay. This works.</d>.

overall_soundscape:
Soft bathroom room tone, the rustle of a scarf and plastic card, the crackle of paper packaging, the click of a lipstick cap, and the heavy sound of a door swinging shut and latching.
